sceneGraph.actName: Respect to Tamil Nadu Culture & Spirit
sceneGraph.visualDescription: Heritage Gateway: Chennai Central at Sunrise
sceneGraph.voiceoverText: Vanakkam Tamil Nadu! A land where centuries of rich heritage seamlessly weave with unstoppable modern ambition.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Resonant Nadaswaram melody blending smoothly into an inspiring orchestral buildup.

sceneGraph.actName: Respect to Tamil Nadu Culture & Spirit
sceneGraph.voiceoverText: From world-renowned textile craft in Kanchipuram to the agricultural heartlands that feed our nation,
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Nadaswaram continues with soft acoustic tanpura drone; gentle loom percussion sync.

sceneGraph.actName: Respect to Tamil Nadu Culture & Spirit
sceneGraph.voiceoverText: to high-tech industrial corridors and bustling highways, it is your relentless spirit, integrity, and drive that power the economic engine of India.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Full orchestral crescendo with uplifting string arrangement.

sceneGraph.voiceoverText: Established in 2018 as an RBI-approved NBFC, Arka Fincap is present in over 140 branches nationwide with an 1,800-strong dedicated team.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Upbeat, inspiring background score with a steady rhythmic pulse.

sceneGraph.voiceoverText: With dedicated branch desks across Tamil Nadu, our teams provide personalized guidance to every business owner and applicant.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Warm acoustic guitar building melodic clarity with gentle rhythm.

sceneGraph.visualDescription: Small Ticket LAP (STLAP) & Secured Business Loans
sceneGraph.voiceoverText: We deliver dependable Small Ticket LAP and Secured Business Loans to workshop owners, traders, and retail entrepreneurs.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Uplifting piano chords with subtle percussion groove.

sceneGraph.visualDescription: Kirloskar Group Legacy: 130+ Years of Nation Building
sceneGraph.voiceoverText: Backed by the legendary 130-plus year legacy of the Kirloskar Group, our foundation rests on an unshakeable promise of nation-building.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Proud brass fanfare blending into warm orchestral underscore.

sceneGraph.voiceoverText: Guided by Trust, Empathy, and Partnership, we believe character counts as much as capital — living by: Aapka Apna Arka.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Emotional string melody with soft piano accents.

sceneGraph.voiceoverText: Backing your growth demands rock-solid stability. Proudly rated AAA by CRISIL and ICRA, Arka Fincap represents the gold standard of financial safety.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Confident orchestral theme with triumphant brass accents.

sceneGraph.visualDescription: Tamil Nadu Regional Hub Network Expansion
sceneGraph.voiceoverText: Guided by leadership strategic vision, we are swiftly expanding our regional hub networks across Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy, Salem, and Cuddalore, targeting a 1,000 Crore Tamil Nadu footprint.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Driving orchestral momentum with modern electronic percussion.

sceneGraph.visualDescription: Arka Fincap Brand Outro & Partnership Call
sceneGraph.voiceoverText: Together, let us build a stronger, more prosperous tomorrow. Partner with us as we continue to drive financial progress and business growth. Arka Fincap Limited — Aapka Apna Kirloskar.
sceneGraph.bgmCue: Grand finale orchestral swell with triumphant resolution and brand signature chime.
